title: Single Cartesian proper refinement normalization
statement: Let A be a finite commutative ring, f:X→Y any scheme morphism, s and r supplied compactifications of f, and rs:r.Refinement s a proper refinement whose square over id_X is Cartesian. The explicit graph map B(s,ofCompactification(r)) from [def-pur-etale-graph-presentation-maps] is the specified derived refinement comparison rho(rs), followed by the inverse of openNormalization(r). The refinement comparison is the derived unit, inverse refinement open base change, and canonical K-injective direct-image compositor in LowerShriekIndependenceUnbounded.lean. No quasi-compactness is assumed.

source.place: Single Cartesian proper refinement normalization; Tags 0F7B--0F7F and the explicit graph formula in LowerShriekComposition.lean:193--268. Agent specialization/pasting argument, not a claim that the upstream file states this equality.

proof.text: Construct the literal proper graph z=(1,rs.hom) and its two Cartesian neighborhood squares. Use their specified transports; no endpoint isomorphism is chosen.
The middle graph word followed by transport2 equals transport1, by the intersection transport theorem.

The two side boundary equations give B1 transport1=rho and B2 transport2=openNormalization(r). Expand the actual graph map as B1 middle B2 inverse. Substitute the middle equation, insert transport2 followed by its inverse, and cancel. Substitute the side equations to obtain rho followed by openNormalization(r) inverse.

proof_origin.place: C9: explicit graph geometry and isomorphism cancellation from the separate intersection and side boundary equations, following original steps 2--4 and Tags 0F7C--0F7E.

theorem etaleGraphFromOpen_refinement
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Y} (s r : Compactification f)
    (rs : r.Refinement s) (hs : IsPullback r.i (𝟙 X) rs.hom s.i) :
    etaleGraphComparisonFromOpen A s (EtaleGraphPresentation.ofCompactification r) =
      asIso (rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactificationComparison
        (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) rs hs) ≪≫ (etaleGraphOpenNormalization A r).symm
